title: Capability Manifest
description: What one verification adapter can verify, at what authority tier, through what channel, with what freshness and temporal guarantees. See docs/ADAPTERS.md. Additive: does not modify the five frozen schemas.

authority.description: The body whose records this adapter reports. For an aggregator, the underlying authority, not the intermediary.

intermediary.description: Required when any capability declares channel AGGREGATOR: the licensed intermediary actually called.

identifier_queryable.description: False for sources queryable only by name. Such observations feed RESOLVE, never DECIDE, and can never alone establish a Tier A fact.

capabilities.description: An empty array is the null adapter: a registered, honest UNAVAILABLE. It is not a mock and not an omission.

evidence_path.description: Must match the operand path grammar in rule_pack.schema.json.

provides.description: Rule pack validation rule 8 resolves predicate operands against the union of these across the registry.

tier.description: A authority-verifiable, B issuer-attested, C self-declared. See VERDICT_ALGEBRA.md section 3.

channel.description: DIRECT is the authority's own API (factor 1.00); AGGREGATOR is a licensed intermediary relaying it (0.85).

as_of_supported.description: Never assumed. When false, an active_on predicate yields AS_OF_UNSUPPORTED -> UNKNOWN rather than substituting today's answer.

freshness_days.description: Default window; a rule pack may override via constants.freshness_days.

not_found_is_negative.description: The ONLY path from an adapter failure to FAIL. Permitted solely where the register is complete and authoritative for this identifier space. Never inferred.

not_found_justification.description: Names the register and why its coverage is complete. Rendered in the UI beside any FAIL derived from absence.

lawful_bases.description: Bases under which this capability may lawfully be invoked. BIDDER_CONSENT additionally requires a consent_reference on every call.

status.description: AWAITING_CREDENTIALS and UNAVAILABLE both resolve to UNKNOWN at the leaf. Recorded so the UI can say which, and why.

unavailable_reason.description: Required when status is UNAVAILABLE. Shown to the officer verbatim, e.g. 'no lawful programmatic source'.
